    "B's proportionate capital requirement is 1/4 of Rs. 80,000, which equals Rs. 20,000.",
    "Since B's present capital after adjustments is Rs. 15,000, B must bring in Rs. 5,000 (20,000 - 15,000) to meet the required capital."

      "premise_quote": "capitals of A and B are Rs. 45,000 and Rs. 15,000, and it is agreed that the capitals of the partners will be in proportion to their new profit shares, the total capital of the new firm being Rs. 80,000",
